caption:
Stories don't reach new people. Mosseri has confirmed it directly — and everyone reads that as bad news when it's the most useful thing to understand about Instagram.

Each surface has a different job:

→ Reels and Explore run on recommendations. They show you to people who don't follow you. That's acquisition.
→ Feed and Stories run mostly on connected reach — people who already chose you. That's trust and conversion.

Stories rank on how likely you are to tap in, like it, or reply. All three are intimacy signals, not discovery signals.

So stop measuring Stories on views and asking why they're low. Large accounts see Stories reach 1–2% of followers against 8–12% for feed posts. Stories aren't losing — they're doing a different job.

This is why "my Reels go viral but nothing sells" is so common. Those are two separate machines, and most people only built one.

Reels to be found. Stories to be trusted. DMs to close.
